analytics.name: Analytic 1825
analytics.guidance: Defender observes an app gaining input-observation capability (AccessibilityService enablement, default IME set, draw-over-apps permission), then creating an intercept surface (overlay window, accessibility event stream consumption or IME keystroke callbacks), followed by persistence (local keylog/clipboard dump) and/or small, frequent network egress. Chain: capability/permission → listener/overlay activation → bursty input read events → local write → near-term exfil.

tuning.description: Max time from input intercept to persist/exfil (e.g., 5–45s).
Minimum count of input events within window to flag harvesting (e.g., ≥5).
Require overlay creation if Accessibility not present (true/false).
Regex for keylog/clipboard dump destinations in app container.
Known-good analytics/CDN endpoints to suppress FPs.
Foreground/background/Work Profile or Kiosk policy to scope alerts.

analytics.name: Analytic 1826
analytics.guidance: Defender observes an app enabling or using input-capture surfaces (custom keyboard extension with Full Access, abnormal UI text entry interception, pasteboard polling adjacent to login screens), then persisting and/or exfiltrating captured input. Chain: capability/consent (TCC for keyboard Full Access or input privacy domains) → intercept behavior (keyboard extension active, repeated text field ‘editingChanged’/secure entry focus, background pasteboard reads) → local write → near-term egress.

tuning.description: Max time from intercept to persist/exfil (e.g., 5–60s).
Minimum key/commit or editingChanged count to flag harvesting (e.g., ≥10).
Require keyboard Full Access to escalate severity (true/false).
Foreground state, Focus modes, MDM policy.
